text:
anya: heads-up: onboarding Ledgerly finetune (client LoRA). int4 conversion shows dropped decimals on currency extraction. sample below.

lee: oof. paste prompt + outputs?

anya: prompt: "Extract total from: 'Invoice 2026-04-02 | Amount: $2,345.00'"
anya: float32 gold -> {total: "2345.00"}
anya: int4 -> {total: "234500"} :sob: (decimal lost, digits concatenated)

devon: that smells like BPE merge combining comma+digits into one token in quant path. which tokenizer? customer's custom-merges.json?

anya: yes, custom-merges.json provided. conversion command:
```bash
redwood-convert --model ledgerly-lora:v1 --out ledgerly-int4.bin --quant int4 --group-size 128
```

hao: try detokenizing with original tokenizer after generation to see if decode table mismatch. also dump token ids.

anya: token ids float32: [12, 34, 56, 7, 89]  int4: [12, 34, 56789] -> merged 56789 id in int4 path

ml-ci-bot: job ledgerly/int4-smoke #4623 started by anya at 2026-03-23T16:40:01Z

devon: agree conversion likely reordered vocab. action items: 1) confirm tokenizer.json included in model tar; 2) re-run convert with --preserve-token-ids; 3) add token-parity assert to conversion CI.

anya: created quick-eval pack 'ledgerly-edge-invoices' (15 cases) and uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/ledgerly/edgepack.json

ml-ci-bot: job ledgerly/int4-smoke #4623 finished: FAILED (regressions=6/15)

hao: rollback to float32 on customer Dedicated. i'll open infra ticket for pinned version.

devon: i'll add lightweight conversion check that runs a handful of numeric tokens through both pipelines and fails conversion if ids differ.

anya: thanks all. will link PR + eval results when ready :thumbsup:
